method: Independent visual inspection of the two supplied actual fight.js renders; no image edits or repository changes.

checks.observation: Both camera positions show continuous landscape-to-floor coverage. No sky-colored horizontal gap beneath distant terrain or middle props.
Higgs and Fragile feet visually meet the gravel plane; no apparent floating or significant sinking. Contact shadows remain readable.
The space between fighters stays clear. Background tents, valley and waterfall provide depth without crossing the foreground fighting lane.
Cropped cargo case/strap on left and tarp/stakes on right stay low at the outer edges, below the fighters lower legs in these views; no tall center occluders.
No visible red outline, opaque fringe or colored spill from the alpha1–2 edge pixels in either final composition.
Bright overcast light, matte compacted gravel without puddles, olive vegetation and familiar camp placement form a consistent dry counterpart.

limits: Approval concerns these two static rendered compositions. The parent separately reports eight runtime cases passed; this review does not independently claim browser or motion testing.
